## Keeper Security, Inc. - Senior Software Engineer, Developer Tools – SDKs

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/keepersecurity/jobs/4425444009)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior engineer leading Python/.NET SDKs, CLI tooling, and automation for Keeper Security’s cybersecurity platform. Guiding architecture, hands-on development, and a small engineering team.
Senior engineer leading SDKs and developer tools for Keeper Security’s cybersecurity platform
- Tech stack: Ansible, AWS, Azure, Cloud, Cyber Security, Google Cloud Platform, Jenkins, Linux, MacOS, Python, Terraform, Vault, Go, .NET
- Guide the architecture, development and evolution of Keeper Commander, including its SDKs, CLI tooling and developer automation capabilities
- Own technical direction and execution across Keeper’s Python and .NET SDKs, Commander CLI and related developer automation capabilities
- Remain hands-on in architecture, coding, debugging and design while guiding a small team of engineers
- Work with Product, QA, Security and engineering teams to ensure Commander is secure, reliable, extensible and easy to integrate
- Define and drive technical architecture and long-term direction
- Design, build and maintain secure, scalable SDKs and developer tools across Python and .NET
- Lead development of CLI features, APIs and integrations for enterprise administrators, developers and DevOps teams
- Architect integrations with CI/CD platforms, cloud services, infrastructure automation tools and enterprise systems
- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on development with Python and .NET
- Strong experience building SDKs, APIs, CLIs, developer tools, automation frameworks or platform integrations
- Proven ability to design and evolve software architectures used by external developers or enterprise customers
- Strong understanding of API design, backward compatibility, versioning and developer experience
- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP and associated APIs and security services
- Familiarity with DevOps and infrastructure automation tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible or Azure DevOps
- Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, secrets management, encryption and secure software development
- Experience designing and troubleshooting distributed or integration-heavy systems

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior engineer leading Python/.NET SDKs, CLI tooling, and automation for Keeper Security’s cybersecurity platform. Guiding architecture, hands-on development, and a small engineering team.
Senior engineer leading SDKs and developer tools for Keeper Security’s cybersecurity platform
Role description:
• Guide the architecture, development and evolution of Keeper Commander, including its SDKs, CLI tooling and developer automation capabilities
• Own technical direction and execution across Keeper’s Python and .NET SDKs, Commander CLI and related developer automation capabilities
• Remain hands-on in architecture, coding, debugging and design while guiding a small team of engineers
• Work with Product, QA, Security and engineering teams to ensure Commander is secure, reliable, extensible and easy to integrate
• Define and drive technical architecture and long-term direction
• Design, build and maintain secure, scalable SDKs and developer tools across Python and .NET
• Lead development of CLI features, APIs and integrations for enterprise administrators, developers and DevOps teams
• Architect integrations with CI/CD platforms, cloud services, infrastructure automation tools and enterprise systems
• Establish technical standards for SDK design, versioning, compatibility, error handling, testing and documentation
• Write production code and troubleshoot complex features and issues
• Lead architecture reviews, design discussions and technical decision-making
• Partner with Product to translate customer needs and platform priorities into scalable solutions
• Collaborate with Security and QA to strengthen secure coding, testing, reliability and release quality
• Diagnose and resolve issues involving performance, concurrency, authentication, integrations and distributed workflows
• Improve developer experience across APIs, documentation, examples, tooling and onboarding
• Support and grow the open-source ecosystem through pull request reviews, issue triage, community engagement and documentation
• Mentor engineers and raise engineering standards through code reviews and design feedback
• Plan and sequence technical initiatives while balancing delivery, maintainability and technical debt
• Evaluate technologies and patterns that improve SDK performance, security, extensibility and developer productivity
• Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms for coding, debugging, research, testing and documentation
Role requirements:
• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on development with Python and .NET
• Strong experience building SDKs, APIs, CLIs, developer tools, automation frameworks or platform integrations
• Proven ability to design and evolve software architectures used by external developers or enterprise customers
• Strong understanding of API design, backward compatibility, versioning and developer experience
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP and associated APIs and security services
• Familiarity with DevOps and infrastructure automation tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible or Azure DevOps
• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, secrets management, encryption and secure software development
• Experience designing and troubleshooting distributed or integration-heavy systems
• Strong debugging skills across application, API, network and integration layers
• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD and release engineering practices
• Experience contributing to, maintaining or supporting open-source software
• Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction without relying solely on formal authority
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly
• Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively for software development, debugging, research and documentation
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• Due to this role’s involvement in GovCloud environments, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident
• Preferred: Experience leading a small engineering team or serving as a technical lead
• Preferred: Experience with secrets management, privileged access management, identity security or cybersecurity platforms
• Preferred: Experience with Go, PowerShell or other automation-oriented languages
• Preferred: Experience developing cross-platform software for Linux, Windows and macOS
• Preferred: Familiarity with AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager or similar cloud security services
• Preferred: Experience with package distribution, dependency management and SDK release workflows
• Preferred: Contributions to widely used SDKs, CLI tools, developer platforms or DevOps automation projects
• Preferred: Experience designing public APIs or developer-facing integration platforms
Benefits:
• Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
• Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
• Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
• 401K (Roth/Traditional)
• A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
• Above market annual bonuses
Tech stack:
Ansible, AWS, Azure, Cloud, Cyber Security, Google Cloud Platform, Jenkins, Linux, MacOS, Python, Terraform, Vault, Go, .NET
